summary.text: Eric Lee is the Democratic candidate for Georgia State Senate District 42, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Bret Dunn.
Senior pastor of Springfield Baptist Church, he advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Eric Lee earned a bachelor's degree from Morehouse College and a graduate degree from Vanderbilt University, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation pastor who earned a Master of Divinity from Vanderbilt University Divinity School and has been Senior Pastor of Springfield Baptist Church since 1999.
He said the congregation has grown from roughly 162 members to more than 7,000 under his leadership.
He listed affordability, opportunity and community as his campaign's key messages, and noted that Georgia has not raised its minimum wage in 25 years.
